question: Which of the following is NOT an east flowing river of Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragiri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The longest river in **Kerala's Kasaragod district is the Chandragiri River,** popularly known as the Perumpuzha River.
 
• Chandragupta Maurya, a** Mauryan monarch**, inspired its naming. On the river stands the **Chandragiri Fort**, which dates to the **17th century.**
 
• The** Payaswini River separates the 'Tulunadu',** which includes the Karnataka districts of Udupi and **Dakshina Kannada **as well as the northern reaches of the** Kasaragod district,** from the Malayalam-speaking areas. Additionally, Kasaragod district's **Chandragiri River**, popularly known as the river, is the** longest river in the area**. 
 
• The **Payaswani River **is one of Kasaragod's more notable rivers. The Chandragiri River,** Kasaragod's longest river**, is where the Payaswani River, which has its origins in the east, meets. The** Chandragiri River **has a maximum length of **105 kilometres. ​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the **Idukki district of Kerala state **in South India, the Pambar River has its beginnings close to **Anamudi. **Three rivers in South India go by the name of **Pambar: Pambar River in Northern Tamil Nadu,** Pambar River in Southern Tamil Nadu, and Pambar River overall (Kerala).
 
• A river called **Bhavani runs through the Indian states of Kerala **and Tamil Nadu. It is one among the three rivers in Kerala that flow eastward and has its origins in the** Western Ghats.**
 
• One of the main** tributaries of the river Cauvery in southern India **is the Kabini River. It has its beginnings close to Kavilumpara in Kerala's Kozhikode district, where the** Panamaram and Mananthavady **rivers converge.
